name: Resurrection

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

summary: Revive a creature dead up to a century with all its Hit Points; it takes a -4 penalty to D20 Tests that fades over four Long Rests.
text: Works unless the creature died of old age or was Undead; it also ends poisons, closes mortal wounds and restores missing parts. The -4 penalty to D20 Tests drops by 1 per Long Rest. Reviving a creature dead 365 days or more leaves you unable to cast spells and with Disadvantage on D20 Tests until you finish a Long Rest.
